comments.author: Paulien
comments.body:
Don't get confused with other Imperial Quest "Surveying India and to the East".. If you don't have Flying Inner Jib, you can buy also in Manila sailmaker.

Note: In my case, I took this Imperial Quest AFTER got South East Asia Port Permit

comments.author: George
comments.body: Ambon and Ternate also have FIJ

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Thanks for the extra info. The reason I suggested Goa and Muscat is due to their proximity to Calicut, and the fact that neither town required a SEA port permit -- players doing Imperial Quests out of Calicut for the first time wouldn't have access to those towns yet, after all.
